---Script #12 – for data profiling | Record Count (BUSC) - w/ Balance (YTD only)
SELECT 
DEP_GAM.FORACID AS [Account_ID]
,CRM_ACC.ORGKEY AS [CIF_ID]
,DGC.GenerationalCohortName AS [Age_Group] 
,DGC.GenerationalCohortDescription AS [Age_Range] 
,CASE WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND (DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) >= 10000000 THEN 'VIP'
WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND (DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) < 1 THEN 'MM' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentName END AS [TRB_Segment] 
,CASE WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND (DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) >= 10000000 THEN 'TRB >= P10M'
WHEN DMS.MarketSegmentSK IS NULL AND (DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) < 1 THEN 'TRB < P2K' ELSE DMS.MarketSegmentDescription END AS [TRB_Segment_Range] 
,DC.CustomerType AS [Customer_Type] 
,CASE WHEN (DC.ATMEnrollmentIndicator = 'Y' OR DC.MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator = 'Y' OR DC.OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator = 'Y') THEN 'Y'  
ELSE 'N' END AS [Digital_Enrollment] 
,DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS [Currency] 
,CASE WHEN DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN 'FCDU'
    WHEN DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 'PHP'
    ELSE NULL END AS [Currency_Category] 
,DP.ProductName AS [Product_Name] 
,DP.ProductGroup AS [Category] 
,DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) AS [YTD_ADB_Orig] 
---,DEP_EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS [Book_Balance_Orig] 
,CASE WHEN DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE != 'PHP' THEN (DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)) * RATELIST.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS  
    ELSE DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE) END AS [YTD_ADB_PhpConverted]  
---,CASE WHEN DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE != 'PHP' THEN (DEP_EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL) * RATELIST.VAR_CRNCY_UNITS  
---    ELSE DEP_EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL END AS [Book_Balance_PHPConverted] 
,DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS [Business_Date] 
,DC.Gender AS [Gender] 

FROM (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG = 'N') DEP_AAS
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG = 'N') DEP_GAM 
    ON  DEP_AAS.ACID = DEP_GAM.ACID AND DEP_AAS.BANK_ID = DEP_GAM.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM 
    (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ACID, BANK_ID ORDER BY CURRENT_EOD_DATE DESC) AS RN, *  FROM busc.DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCES) A
        WHERE RN = 1) DEP_YTD 
    ON DEP_GAM.ACID = DEP_YTD.ACID AND DEP_GAM.BANK_ID = DEP_YTD.BANK_ID
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE WHERE isLatest = 1) DEP_EAB 
--    ON DEP_GAM.ACID = DEP_EAB.ACID AND DEP_GAM.BANK_ID = DEP_EAB.BANK_ID AND (DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE BETWEEN DEP_EAB.EOD_DATE AND DEP_EAB.END_EOD_DATE)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.CRM_ACCOUNTS WHERE isActive = 1 AND isLatest = 1 AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01') CRM_ACC
    ON DEP_AAS.CUST_ID = CRM_ACC.CORE_CUST_ID AND DEP_AAS.BANK_ID = CRM_ACC.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM dw.DimCustomer WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'CRM' AND BankSK = 1) DC
    ON CRM_ACC.ORGKEY = DC.CustomerID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ProductID, ProductName, ProductGroup FROM dw.DimProduct WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') DP 
    ON DEP_GAM.SCHM_CODE = DP.ProductID
LEFT JOIN dw.DimGenerationalCohort DGC 
    ON DC.GenerationalCohortSK = DGC.GenerationalCohortSK AND DC.CurrentIndicator = DGC.CurrentIndicator  
LEFT JOIN DW.DimMarketSegment DMS  
    ON ISNULL((DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)),0) >= DMS.LowerLimit AND ISNULL((DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(dayofyear, DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE)),0) < DMS.UpperLimit 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM busc.GLD_RATELIST_HIST_TABLE WHERE RATECODE = 'REV' AND BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND DEL_FLG = 'N' AND VAR_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP') RATELIST 
    ON DEP_YTD.CURRENT_EOD_DATE = RATELIST.RTLIST_DATE AND DEP_GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = RATELIST.FXD_CRNCY_CODE
